purpose: Resolve physical SiteID continuity and mutual exclusivity before explicit-zero occupancy histories are inspected for spatial-recovery hysteresis.

allowed_evidence: BTO/SMP provider-supplied SiteID/MasterSite crosswalk or change log
provider confirmation that an ID is a stable Whole Colony child Site over the retained interval
prohibited: choosing continuity based on whether a SiteID helps the hypothesis

retained_site_rule: A SiteID may enter the hysteresis state scan only if stable_identity=true, mutually_exclusive_child=true, overlaps_parent_or_sibling=false, boundary_change_during_panel=false, and retired_or_replaced=false over the retained complete-year interval.

panel_rule.roster_repair: After removing identity-ineligible SiteIDs, retain the exact inherited count-blind complete-year set from Stage A. Do not extend the time series into additional years merely because removing a SiteID would make them complete.
panel_rule.program_thresholds: Use the dedicated hysteresis structure thresholds: >=10 eligible panels, >=10 distinct MasterSites, >=5 species. No geographic-region or multi-panel-per-species criterion is imposed at Stage A; replication requirements are enforced at the completed-spell Stage B gate.
panel_rule.multiple_unit_rule: If more than one structurally eligible Count Unit remains for the same species x MasterSite, exclude that species x MasterSite unless the provider identifies a canonical primary Unit before zero/positive states or magnitudes are opened. No unit conversion or outcome-based unit choice.
panel_rule.rationale_for_no_year_extension: This conservative rule prevents the identity-resolution step from creating a new observation window and keeps all later occupancy-state cycles inside the originally frozen support years.

decision.if_site_history_unavailable: Do not open the hysteresis occupancy-state test. The hypothesis requires stable physical SiteID identity.
decision.if_passed: Freeze the identity-resolved hysteresis panel roster under the dedicated 10-panel / 10-MasterSite / 5-species support rule and authorize provider-confirmed explicit-zero/positive Stage B.
